svg.title: Red fox
svg.desc: Standing red fox with a slender canid frame, russet coat, black distal legs, pointed ears, narrow muzzle, and bushy white-tipped tail. Biological basis: Foxes provide comparative canid models in ecology, infectious disease, behavior, and domestication research rather than serving as routine laboratory rodents.
